chunks: Yet when the eyes are dazzled,

key_terms.بَرِقَ: to dazzle or lose focus (of the eyes)

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the eyes are dazzled in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase from Surah Al-Qiyamah captures the visceral terror of the Hereafter, where the 'flash' (barq) of the eyes signifies the sudden, blinding realization of divine truth that strips away worldly illusions. It reflects the moment when the soul's perception shifts from the material veil to the direct encounter with God's majesty, a theme emphasized by scholars like Allamah Tabatabai as the collapse of human composure before the ultimate reality.
